content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: in all three sessions the user clicked the Apply span at nearly the same spot five times in about a second, and no navigation, error, overlay, or other state-change event follows those clicks before the next action several seconds later, so the button appears to give no immediate feedback.", "fix": "Fix: on the Apply button in the \"ir swap:screen\" screen, disable the control and show an in-progress indicator (or a \"Applying...\" label) on the first click, so repeat clicks are blocked and the response is visible right away.", "cited_event_ids": ["108", "114", "119", "125", "130", "133:155", "146", "151", "156", "162", "167", "170:191", "122", "128", "134", "139", "145", "147:183"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The event stream does not record rendered UI changes, so whether Apply showed any visual feedback is not confirmed.", "Whether Apply's request succeeded or failed is not visible in these windows; the app_action success events occur only after later Save/Recalc steps.", "The exact reason the clicked span position shifts between x=250 and x=275 is not determined.", "The earlier error events on Trade Date and Counterparty are not linked to the Apply clicks and were not used as the cause."]}
